coordinate_factorization.definitions: For coordinate i, m_j=u_i*u_j^2 for the seven other coordinates in its E8 block; f=(16*u_i-u_i^3)/3; g=(u_i^3-4*u_i)/3. Let h_T=sum_{j in T}m_j-f for the seven Fano triples. In each other block let b_k=sum_j H[k,j]*u_i*u_j^2, k=0,...,7. Retain all distinct-coordinate cubic monomials supported on at most two blocks. Add g, the seven h_T, the seven b_k with k>0 per other block, and the listed trace center(s) b_0 or b_0+c_0 and b_0-c_0.
coordinate_factorization.identity: 3*f=sum_j m_j+sum_other_blocks b_0. The Fano identity is sum_j m_j*m_j_prime-f*f_prime = (sum_T h_T*h_T_prime-(sum_other_blocks b_0)*(sum_other_blocks b_0_prime))/2. Hadamard transforms give each other-block contribution sum_k b_k*b_k_prime/8. The displayed trace coefficients diagonalize the remaining one- or two-variable form.
coordinate_factorization.scope: An exact scalar factorization and support bill, not a complete recursive circuit or a new kappa.
coordinate_factorization.support_proof: All support rows, including zero tests, are exhausted for one representative of each listed orbit. Block permutations and within-block coordinate permutations preserve the lattice and induce invertible binary label maps. They act transitively on the listed center supports: a Fano center chooses a three-subset among seven coordinates, and a nonconstant Hadamard row chooses a balanced four/four partition. Thus the representative support dimensions apply to every center. Encoder and decoder supports agree because this factorization is symmetric and diagonal.

fitting.identity: p(u) dot p(v) = 1 + (u dot v / 4) mod 2
fitting.universal_proof: The eight E8 basis roots have an odd integral Gram determinant. In lattice pairing coordinates its rational inverse reduces to the displayed binary inverse. Two orthogonal blocks give the alternating rank-16 form; the verified even-space isometry and the orthogonal all-ones vector realize it by the standard dot product in dimension 17.

operator_factorization.mixed_center_rule: For each ordered pair of distinct E8 blocks A,B, each coordinate i in A, and each of the 35 operators P, use u_A,i * (u_B^T P u_B).
operator_factorization.operator_rule: P_(a,b)e_x=(-1)^(b dot x)e_(x+a), a,b,x in F2^3, a dot b=0. Omit (a,b)=(0,0).
operator_factorization.proof: The 36 explicitly checked symmetric Pauli matrices are an orthogonal basis of Sym_8 with squared Frobenius norm8; this proves the quadratic identity for all real u,v. The identity replaces the seven nonconstant diagonal Hadamard centers and 28 mixed off-diagonal cubic centers per ordered block/coordinate by35 Pauli centers, all with coefficient1/8192. The trace direction is unchanged, so the prior Fano trace diagonalization and the full kernel identity remain exact. All35 support sets are exhausted on actual ports; block permutations and permutations within the linear block cover all coordinate choices. Encoder and decoder supports agree in this symmetric dyadic diagonal factorization.
operator_factorization.quadratic_identity: sum_{P nonidentity} (u^T P u)*(v^T P v) = 8*(u dot v)^2 - (u dot u)*(v dot v)
operator_factorization.scope: Exact rank-minimal scalar factorization, binary support bill, and a genuine reduction versus the coordinate basis. Helper exits, a finite recursive word, and a new kappa remain separate obligations.

real_rank.proof: Pure sectors and opposite relative signs separate independent cubic spaces, using the displayed finite rank witnesses 120,36,8. For the retained cubic feature matrix F, K=F(D-64 L L^T)F^T/3072. Since the shell norm is16 in doubled coordinates, u_i=sum_j u_i*u_j^2/16, and L^T D^-1 L=((8*blocks+2)/768)I. The nonzero displayed correction eigenvalue proves the exact real rank.

shared_support_frames.scope: Exact binary support subspaces of the two-block Pauli factorization. The width15 subspaces are degenerate (restricted dot rank13), so any helper theorem must handle those subspaces. Sharing a frame nominates batches; no helper schedule or routing cost is inferred.

relative_sign_walsh.pair_kernel_after_transform: For two AB ports in the odd-A sector, s_A*(s_A^2+3*s_B^2-4)/24, where s_A and s_B are ordinary root inner products.
relative_sign_walsh.proof: Every retained cubic or linear feature is odd in exactly one block. Transform each present relative-sign pair (a,b),(a,-b) by H on inputs and H/2 on outputs. This same-label similarity preserves the binary labels and unit diagonal, and separates the odd-block characters. Pure ports already have one character. At a fixed root a, the same-sector pair kernel is s_B^2/4, whose real rank is36 by the exact root-quadratic witness; this is not an eight-dimensional E8 frame replication.
relative_sign_walsh.same_label_identity: p(a,b)=p(a,-b), since all lattice pairings agree modulo two.
relative_sign_walsh.scope: An exact free change of basis within equal-label ports. It does not by itself supply improved helper exits or a complete recursive word.
